```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# DO NOT ALTER CODE IN THIS CHUNK
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
```

#### Loading data
```{r}
data <- read.csv("TCGA-PANCAN-HiSeq-801x20531/data.csv")
labels <- read.csv("TCGA-PANCAN-HiSeq-801x20531/labels.csv")

dim(data)
dim(labels)

head(data)
head(labels)
```


```{r}
# 1. Target Class Frequency Distribution
class_table <- table(labels$Class)
class_df <- as.data.frame(class_table)
colnames(class_df) <- c("CancerType", "Count")

cat("Target Class Counts:\n")
class_df

# Plot Class Distribution
ggplot(class_df, aes(x = reorder(CancerType, -Count), y = Count, fill = CancerType)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = Count), vjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold", size = 3.5) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Figure 1: Sample Distribution Across 5 Primary Cancer Types",
       x = "Cancer Type", y = "Number of Samples")

# 2. Log2 Transformation: log2(x + 1)
# Exclude non-numeric patient ID column if present
gene_matrix <- data[, sapply(data, is.numeric)]
expr_log <- log2(gene_matrix + 1)

# Inspect transformed data summary for the first gene
summary(expr_log[, 1])

# 3. Variance Filtering & Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
# Calculate gene-wise variance across all 801 samples
gene_vars <- apply(expr_log, 2, var)

# Filter top 1,000 highest-variance genes for dimensionality reduction
top_1000_genes <- head(order(gene_vars, decreasing = TRUE), 1000)
filtered_expr <- expr_log[, top_1000_genes]

# Fit Principal Component Analysis (PCA)
pca_res <- prcomp(filtered_expr, center = TRUE, scale. = TRUE)

# Create PCA plotting dataframe
pca_df <- data.frame(
  PC1 = pca_res$x[, 1],
  PC2 = pca_res$x[, 2],
  CancerType = factor(labels$Class)
)

var_explained <- round(summary(pca_res)$importance[2, 1:2] * 100, 1)

# Plot PCA Projection (PC1 vs PC2)
ggplot(pca_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = CancerType)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Figure 2: 2D PCA Projection of Top Variable Genes",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", var_explained[1], "% Variance)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", var_explained[2], "% Variance)"),
       color = "Cancer Type")
```
